uptime_status.reason: v1 metric surface (8 ao_* families) does NOT expose a service health / freshness signal. Service uptime SLI requires an operator-deployed Prometheus 'up' target or a future health metric; deferred to a follow-up slice.

indicators.name: llm_usage_accounting_completeness
indicators.description: Fraction of LLM transport calls for which usage (tokens/cost) was successfully accounted. NOT a 'call success rate' — measures usage attribution completeness, not transport success. Codex 019e8394 iter-2 absorb: bounded denominator = duration_count + usage_missing_total (NOT just duration_count, which only counts accounted calls).

indicators.name: llm_latency_under_30s_ratio
indicators.description: Fraction of LLM transport calls completing within 30 seconds. Bucket-ratio form is alertable for error-budget burn; the operator-facing p95 target is documented in docs/SLI-SLO.md.

indicators.name: workflow_terminal_success_rate
indicators.description: Fraction of TERMINATED workflow runs (final_state='completed' vs 'failed' / 'cancelled'). In-flight workflows are not counted; uptime gap remains out of scope.

indicators.name: policy_deny_rate
indicators.description: Policy deny ratio (deny / (allow + deny)). Codex 019e8394 absorb: 'deny' is a policy decision, NOT an error; outcome='error' is NOT exposed by the metric surface. Advisory observability only.

indicators.name: monthly_cost_burn_projection_usd
indicators.description: Projected USD burn over a 30-day window from the current 1h cost rate. NOT a ratio SLO; budget objective. Tenant-bound objective is out of scope (no tenant label on ao_llm_cost_usd_total in v1).

indicators.name: coordination_takeover_rate
indicators.description: Coordination claim takeovers per hour normalized by average active claims. Advisory only — no baseline data yet; hard SLO promotion requires baseline measurement + operator decision.
